crossRefs.note: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;
then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.
They heard Yahweh God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves…
even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person…
They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from…

translations.web: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
translations.bsb: Only grant these two things to me, so that I need not hide from You:
translations.kjv: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
translations.asv: Only do not two things unto me; Then will I not hide myself from thy face:
